user_query: I'm planning a surprise party for my parents' anniversary and I want to send WhatsApp invitations to all their friends. Can you check if their friends' phone numbers are valid and if they belong to WhatsApp for Business accounts? Also, fetch the contacts in my parents' WhatsApp instance so I can invite them all!

TaskList.description: Fetch the contacts from your parents' WhatsApp instance.
Retrieve the phone numbers of your parents' friends to check their validity and WhatsApp for Business status.
Validate the retrieved phone numbers and check if they belong to WhatsApp for Business accounts.
